title: Fix first_words returning one word too many
body: first_words in textkit/tokens.py returns one more word than requested. Repro: first_words('alpha beta gamma delta', 2) returns 'alpha beta gamma', expected 'alpha beta' (exactly the first 2 words). Its docstring already specifies that it returns the first n words, that n <= 0 returns the empty string, and that a text with fewer than n words returns all of them. The n <= 0 and over-length cases are correct and all existing tests pass. Fix the exact-count case and add a regression test covering it.
